_readme: Registry nhan vat dung chung cho pipeline autovid.
Moi khoa la mot bo frame cua mot nhan vat:
image_file : tu the nghi (dung gan nua thoi gian)
mouth      : patch moi dong/mo dap LEN sprite (than giu nguyen 100%).
anchor x/y + size la ti le so voi anh goc da trim;
images[0] PHAI la patch MIENG DONG: pipeline giu no khi
ngat nghi (mip moi theo giong doc that tu stage 2).
cat bang: python3 tools/cut_mouth_from_frames.py
talk       : cac frame thay TOAN BO anh (can cap anh chi khac mieng)
poses      : cac tu the khac (auto_pose_s xoay vong). Khi co mouth,
poses chi xoay vong o KHOANG NGHI giua cac cau (doc)
chuoi pose vo dich vua no cuoi cau); khong co mouth thi
poses xoay vong ca phan chua.
idle       : chuyen dong dung yen mac dinh (bob/sway/bob_sway/shake/
talk/tilt). 'tilt' = lac dau xoay nguoi nhe, do bang DO:
amplitude_px la so do (toi da 15), period_s la chu ky.
Ap dung vao script: python3 tools/apply_character_registry.py projects/<id>/script.json
Script van ghi de tay duoc: talk/poses/mouth/auto_pose_s/idle viet trong
scene thang registry (ghi ro trong script se thang).
Tach nen anh moi: python3 tools/remove_background.py <anh-hoac-thu-muc>
-> xuat *_cut.png RGBA san sang dung lam pose/talk.
Nhan vat dan truyen cho khung ke chuyen (story_frame).
resting = dang CHI TAY ve phia khung (ben trai man hinh);
poses = tu the tha loi xuat hien trong khoang nghi giua cau.
mouth anchor/size tinh theo anh resting da trim.
Ke su - nhan vat cua user, tac tu assets/characters/Part/image.png (8 frame).
resting = DANG CHI TAY (ke_01_point); poses xoay vong o khoang nghi:
nghi -> tu the khac, het nghi -> ve chi tay => hieu ung 'vung tay chi'.
mouth anchor/size do thu cong tren frame chi tay (da kiem tra bang anh check).
Ke su ban cuoi suong: resting la frame CUOI TO (ke_02_laugh),
idle bob_sway cho dau luc luc nhu vua noi vua cuoi. Phu hop
khi ke chuyen phan hap dan / tiet lac.
Ke su soc: resting la frame SOC (ke_04_shock), idle shake de
dau lac lac khong tin. Phu hop cho plot twist / drama.
Ke su chay bo: resting la frame CHAY (ke_08_run), idle bob nhanh
nhu dang chay tai cho while ke chuyen. Vinh dia cho noi nhanh.
